name: laporan-generator
postCreateCommand: if [ ! -x /nix/var/nix/profiles/default/bin/nix ]; then curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf -L https://install.determinate.systems/nix | sh -s -- install linux --init none --no-confirm; fi; if [ ! -S /nix/var/nix/daemon-socket/socket ]; then sudo nohup /nix/var/nix/profiles/default/bin/nix-daemon > /tmp/nix-daemon.log 2>&1 & sleep 2; fi
postStartCommand: if [ ! -x /nix/var/nix/profiles/default/bin/nix ]; then curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf -L https://install.determinate.systems/nix | sh -s -- install linux --init none --no-confirm; fi; if [ ! -S /nix/var/nix/daemon-socket/socket ]; then sudo nohup /nix/var/nix/profiles/default/bin/nix-daemon > /tmp/nix-daemon.log 2>&1 & sleep 2; fi
